detail.longDescription: Just read: https:// vivianvoss.net/blog/jails-vs-c ontainers Biased, missing a bunch of points. E.g., there are no # FreeBSD jails with a single binary, at least AFAIK, as of now. The lack of a registry makes jails inconvenient. And without orchestration, they do not nearly offer the same features for a flexibly scalable platform as, say, # Kubernetes . The post acknowledges that, sort of. To gain more convenience, Luca had started pot for managing jails: https:// codeberg.org/bsdpot/pot That gets you a bit closer to containers.
